34698b52.text: Chickpea is possible_with_care. In a dry year rain covers only 35% of its water need; but TÜİK reports rain-fed chickpea in this province in 5 of the last 5 years (about 3070 ha a year), so local varieties and practice manage it somewhere in the province; check that your field is like those. Also, chickpea after lentil, a crop of the same family; they share some pests and diseases.
34698b52.label: sanliurfa check chickpea

4d5c92e3.text: Nohut için mevcut ekim nöbeti dikkatle yapılabilir durumdadır. Kurak bir yılda yağış su ihtiyacının yalnızca %35 oranını karşılar, ancak yerel tarım istatistikleri bu ilde son 5 yılın 5 yılında kıraç nohut bildirmiştir. Tarlanızın bu koşullara uyup uymadığını kontrol edin ve alternatif olarak arpa, yulaf veya buğday seçeneklerini de değerlendirin.
4d5c92e3.label: sanliurfa check chickpea

e4bbc36b.text: Wheat is possible with care because rain and stored soil water cover 39% of wheat's water need (~395 mm) in a dry year, leaving a shortfall of about 240 mm (240 m³ per dekar, 2,400 m³ per hectare) that extra watering would make up, mostly in Mar (~72 mm) and Apr (~99 mm). On the positive side, having lentil before wheat raised the next crop's yield by about 20% on average across 462 studies in 53 countries, and lentil fixes about 53 kg N per hectare, part of which is left for wheat. Check that about 264 mm of rain falls here in a dry year, which is below the 300 mm a year that rain-fed wheat needs.
e4bbc36b.label: sanliurfa check wheat
